thread:
sophie (oncall): :rotating_light: incident bot paged for high tail latency on cont-batch nodes in us-west-2. spike started ~00:00 UTC, p95 -> 3s, p99 -> 12s. seeing KV cache evictions ramping in the same window.
sophie (oncall): stack: cont-batch worker pool -> kvcache -> runtime-hotpath. customer reports multiple 5xxs.
incident-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-177777 (continuous-batch latency spike). Pager routed to sophie.
leo (eng-runtime): pulling perf dashboard now: https://grafana/redwood/d/cont-batch/us-west-2?panel=latency - large queue depth correlate with microbatch sizes collapsing to 1-2 tokens, CPU stuck on kernel spin.
maya (eng-sre): logs look like aggressive prefetch loop: kv_cache_repopulate retry storms, eviction rate up 6x. probable feedback: prefetch pushes cache entries -> eviction thrash -> misses -> prefetch again.
jamie (prod-ops): confirmed multiple customers in EU-US route hit elevated latency. early impact: webhooks delayed; TB reported 7 user sessions affected. Not wide yet but trending.
sophie (oncall): can we throttle prefetch or disable continuous prefetch at runtime?
leo (eng-runtime): yes. patch ready: set runtime flag cont_batch.prefetch.enabled=false and lower microbatch target. command: 
```
# apply hotfix
kubectl -n redwood patch configmap cont-batch-config -p '{"data":{"prefetch_enabled":"false","microbatch_target":"4","jitter_ms":"6"}}'
```
leo (eng-runtime): I'll stage to canary pool (2 nodes) first, monitor KV hits/evicts and latency.
maya (eng-sre): recommend an orchestration throttle instead of fully disabling prefetch to avoid cold-cache cliff for long-tail customers. maybe set prefetch_enabled=false for non-critical classes and keep token-prefetch for small contexts.
jamie (prod-ops): for visibility we should announce to #customer-impact with initial blurb. low-medium severity. no SLA breach yet.
sophie (oncall): doing handoff to leo for hotfix rollout, staying on thread for escalation. tagging @jamie for customer comms.
leo (eng-runtime): rolling hotfix to canary at 00:05 UTC. commands executed, patch applied.
incident-bot: Deploy started by leo (eng-runtime) to cont-batch-canary group.
leo (eng-runtime): canary shows immediate drop in eviction rate and queue depth. p95 down from 3s -> 220ms, p99 down to ~450ms. KV cache miss rate decreased 45%.
maya (eng-sre): nice. watch for microburst that could cause underbatching. check adaptive-batch logs.
sophie (oncall): customer impact update: TB acknowledged improvement on canary sessions. preparing to broaden to 30% traffic.
leo (eng-runtime): widening patch to 30% now. also flipping jitter_ms from 12 -> 6 to dampen resonance.
jamie (prod-ops): drafting message: "We observed increased latency affecting a subset of inference requests due to a prefetch feedback loop in our continuous batching subsystem. We’ve applied a rolling mitigation and are monitoring. No customer data was exposed."
sophie (oncall): +1. include note that we will revert once we validate stability.
leo (eng-runtime): metrics look stable at 30%. planning full rollout in 12m if no regressions.
maya (eng-sre): watchpoints - KV cache shard pressure, requeue rate, queueing time histogram, microbatch size distribution. alert thresholds adjusted for now.
jamie (prod-ops): customer comms sent to impacted customers at 00:24 UTC.
leo (eng-runtime): monitoring full rollout. applying to remaining pools.
incident-bot: Deploy completed.
sophie (oncall): rolling back the flag to true is a TODO depending on postmortem. for now we have a mitigated state.
jamie (prod-ops): closing loop with customer support: created ticket RED-2345 linking incident.
leo (eng-runtime): saving config diff for postmortem: 
```
- cont_batch:
    prefetch_enabled: true
    microbatch_target: 8
    jitter_ms: 12
+ cont_batch:
    prefetch_enabled: false
    microbatch_target: 4
    jitter_ms: 6
```
maya (eng-sre): recommend follow-ups: 1) add circuit breaker on prefetch retry backoff, 2) cap eviction rate alarm, 3) run chaos tests for jitter resonance, 4) add a slow-rolling canary for config flips.
sophie (oncall): assigning follow-ups to eng-runtime and eng-sre for postmortem and runbook updates. thanks all. :white_check_mark:
